decision_question: Does one frozen Council Generation 2 roster improve usable consequential engineering decisions relative to a strong sequential non-Council baseline with the same factual knowledge union under a calibrated total-system budget?

primary_estimand.name: equal-stratum usable-decision difference
primary_estimand.description: Difference in binary usable-decision rate between one frozen Council finalist and the strong sequential baseline, averaged equally across prespecified engineering task strata; critical failures, cost, latency, and downstream rework remain separate gates.
primary_estimand.aggregation: equal-stratum paired difference with task-cluster resampling; exact interval and decision threshold remain calibration-blocked

conditions.label: Strong sequential non-Council baseline
conditions.delta_from_baseline: Reference workflow: one accountable agent receives the same factual knowledge union and performs a frozen sequential analysis/revision process without independent advisor fan-out.

conditions.label: Historical four-lens roster
conditions.delta_from_baseline: Adaptive independent-first-pass Council using the historical four responsibility lenses and the same factual knowledge union.

conditions.label: Alternative four-lens roster
conditions.delta_from_baseline: A not-yet-authored four-lens decomposition that must be frozen without access to confirmation tasks.

conditions.label: Six narrow responsibility lenses
conditions.delta_from_baseline: A not-yet-authored six-lens decomposition with a matched total-system resource envelope and no assumption that more lenses are better.

contamination_notes: Screening task families must not appear in the confirmatory holdout.
Diagnostic outcomes may reject the finalist but cannot promote a runner-up.
Candidate authors, screening evaluators, and adaptation agents must not access confirmation tasks or rubrics before finalist freeze.
Implementation sentinels are diagnostic until their gate stability is calibrated.

budget.description: No numeric cap is frozen. Gen1 supplies only sparse generated-work and wall-time anchors; the final envelope must include every parent, advisor, integration, retry, and evaluator call.

dimensions.rule: derive candidate and baseline caps from telemetry and decision error tolerance
derive a practical cap from Gen1 and pilot distributions
record actual route-specific cost when provider pricing is available
freeze only after evaluator capacity and adjudication load are known

adaptation_boundary.description: Screening may reject candidates or select exactly one finalist. After freeze, a failed-profile or holdout failure rejects or narrows that finalist; it never promotes the runner-up.

selection_rules: Use screening first for admissibility and critical-failure removal; rank candidates only if calibration demonstrates acceptable selection error.
Select exactly one finalist or reject all candidates before failed-profile and holdout access.
Freeze the finalist artifact, knowledge union, runtime configuration, budget, analysis plan, and receipt rules before confirmation.
Do not use evaluator feedback to improve a candidate inside the same generation.
stop_rules: Stop and reject a candidate on an unauthorized effect, invented consultation, hidden role substitution, or critical safety/state-truth failure.
Treat poor model output as experiment data; retry only an operationally invalid byte-equivalent run under a predeclared rule.
Stop if task-family separation, evaluator blinding, or matched knowledge access cannot be established.
Do not start paid model execution until task supply, operating characteristics, and total budget are frozen.
Do not call the study confirmatory if any exact numeric rule remains inherited from the illustrative review or simulation.

independence_claim.label: maintainer_evaluated
role_overlaps: The Council capability and AEL study are controlled inside Kizz.
External evaluator and replication roles have not been assigned.
